g.text: Best distributional fit — with the mass changes right

g.title: across real single-cell task nubot outperforms every baseline including current
g.desc: Across the real single-cell task, NubOT outperforms every baseline, including the current state-of-the-art unbalanced GAN, in almost all of the twenty-five drug perturbations, measured by a weighted version of kernel maximum mean discrepancy between predicted and observed perturbed cells.
g.text: NubOT wins on almost all 25 drugs by weighted
kernel MMD to observed cells — beating even

g.title: just importantly does while getting mass changes right synthetic benchmark
g.desc: Just as importantly, it does so while getting the mass changes right: on the synthetic benchmark it maps each cluster to its correct target without leaking mass between clusters, and it predicts the exact reweighting each cluster needs, where the GAN baseline only captures the broad direction of growth and shrinkage.
g.text: On synthetic data it maps each cluster to its
correct target and predicts the exact reweighting
— where the GAN gets only the broad direction.

g.title: combination accurate feature mapping accurate mass rescaling what sets nubot
g.desc: This combination of accurate feature mapping and accurate mass rescaling is what sets NubOT apart.
g.text: SYNTHETIC SAMPLE MAPPING · NubOT vs ubOT GAN (FIGURE 2)
Accurate feature mapping AND accurate mass rescaling together are what set NubOT apart.
NubOT · Neural Unbalanced Optimal Transport · NeurIPS 2022
